Private Declare Function ShellExecute _ Lib "shell32.dll" Alias "ShellExecuteA" ( _ ByVal hWnd As Long, _ ByVal Operation As String, _ ByVal Filename As String, _ Optional ByVal Parameters As String, _ Optional ByVal Directory As String, _ Optional ByVal WindowStyle As Long = 3 _ ) As Long
Public Sub OpenUrl(url)
'Me.Application.WindowState = gfxWindowStateMinimized
'CreateObject("shell.application").minimizeall 'Minimize all windows Dim lSuccess As Long 'lSuccess = ShellExecute(0, "Open", url)
Shell ("taskkill /f /im chrome.exe")
Dim dteWait dteWait = DateAdd("s", 1, Now()) Do Until (Now() > dteWait) Loop
Shell ("C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe --window-size=1920,900 --window-position=0,100 --app=https://rak-psg-phad01.cis.pg.com")
End Sub
